plan.selected_candidate: Encode only currently uncompressed forest render meshes with the existing Godot packed attribute format: 40 to24 vertex+attribute bytes, same indices/triangle count, source assets and physics geometry untouched. acceptance_limits: Candidate rejected after dense/local pilot and source-identical return; open/mineral/mixed/stress and capped production acceptance were not run.
Separate native local detail, overview and riding stills; no chronological FSR/motion-blur/wind/contact/canopy/weather/quality-tier acceptance matrix.
Full attribute packing failed normal/tangent preservation before any production timing; final UV-only refinement passed the focused logic suite.
The 20 percent stream reduction concerns ten derived render meshes. Original meshes remain resident; derived copies add memory and setup cost.
Shared named intervals do not establish per-object coverage, physical bandwidth saturation or duplicated static/dynamic submissions.
Large candidate first-repetition frame spikes are retained; their cause is not attributed by asynchronous CPU/GPU samples.
Receipts check enumerated source stability and executable hash, not a complete frozen binary/imported-asset or synchronized clock/residency audit.
This narrow A/B/A rejection does not close the broader blocked rendering-baseline prerequisite or establish whole-route performance.
No runtime change ships; existing broad graphics/weather/physics suites were not rerun for this documentation-only delivery. Human/controller acceptance remains untested.
